description: Undo a soft-delete: clears deletedAt on the given SeoScoredKeyword ids so they reappear in seo_list_keywords / seo_list_keyword_ids. Housekeeping op — not part of the main flow. Use after seo_delete_keyword or seo_bulk_delete_keywords removed something that shouldn't have been removed. IDs that are not currently soft-deleted are silently no-ops (the response's `restored` count only reflects rows that actually changed). Find deleted ids with seo_list_keyword_ids using includeDeleted=true.

keywordIds.description: Keyword IDs to restore (from seo_list_keyword_ids with includeDeleted=true)

name: seo_restore_keyword
